subject: [PATCH v3 8/8] mm/page_alloc: keep a zone's pagesets when it goes empty

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch prevents the freeing of a zone's pagesets when it goes empty, which can lead to memory corruption and leaks. The pagesets are kept for the life of the zone, similar to pgdat->per_cpu_nodestats. This change is necessary because setup_zone_pageset() reuses existing pagesets and zone_pcp_init() keeps them when a node is re-added. The patch fixes a bug introduced by commit 340175b7d14d and addresses issues with memory allocation and deallocation in the presence of kprobes and cond_resched().
